title: Ling-3.2-flash reports 67.77 on BlenderBench alongside its 3D prototyping demos
author: O_ojy
selftext:
BlenderBench is included in the evaluation for Ant Ling's newly released Ling-3.2-flash, with a reported score of 67.77.

For developers following AI-assisted 3D work, the launch pairs that evaluation with two separate demonstrations. One operates Blender's interface to construct a furnished room. The other recreates prototype assets from 2D reference images for games and simulations.

The release therefore covers both operation inside a 3D application and reference-based asset prototyping. Ling-3.2-flash is a native multimodal model with 560B total parameters and 25B active parameters.
